features.name: Ability Score Improvement
features.description: Increase one ability score by 2, or two ability scores by 1 each. No ability score can exceed 20.

features.name: Choose Feat
features.description: Instead of increasing ability scores, choose a feat that grants special abilities.

features.name: Alert
features.description: Always on the lookout for danger, you gain the following benefits: +5 bonus to initiative, can't be surprised while conscious, creatures don't gain advantage on attack rolls from being hidden.

features.name: Lucky
features.description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment.

actions.name: Lucky
actions.description: Reroll an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw

features.name: Great Weapon Master
features.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage, letting its momentum empower your strikes.

actions.name: Power Attack
actions.description: Before making a melee attack with a heavy weapon, take -5 to attack roll for +10 damage

actions.name: Bonus Attack
actions.description: When you score a critical hit or reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee weapon attack, you can make one melee weapon attack

features.name: Sharpshooter
features.description: You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible.

actions.name: Precision Shot
actions.description: Before making a ranged attack, take -5 to attack roll for +10 damage

features.name: Tough
features.description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level when you gain this feat.

features.name: War Caster
features.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat, learning techniques that grant you the following benefits.

actions.name: Opportunity Spell
actions.description: Cast a spell with a casting time of 1 action as an opportunity attack
